+/-- Avoid buffering the output (official old-version compatibility). -/
+def printFlush [ToString α] (s : α) : IO Unit := do
+  let out ← IO.getStdout
+  out.putStr (toString s)
+  out.flush
+
 /-- Read-eval-print loop for Lean. -/
 unsafe def repl : IO Unit :=
   StateT.run' loop {}
 where loop : M IO Unit := do
   let query ← getLines
+  if (Json.parse query >>= fun j => j.getObjValAs? Bool "quit").toOption.getD false then
+    IO.println (Json.mkObj [("bye",toJson true)]).compress
+    printFlush "\n"
+    return ()
   if query = "" then
     return ()
   if query.startsWith "#" || query.startsWith "--" then loop else
   IO.println <| toString <| ← match ← parse query with
   | .command r => return toJson (← runCommand r)
+  | .nativeBatch r => nativeCommandBatch r
+  | .nativeProofBatch r => nativeProofBatch r
+  | .clearProofSnapshots _ => do
+    modify fun s => {s with proofStates := #[]}
+    pure <| Json.mkObj [("cleared",Json.bool true)]
   | .file r => return toJson (← processFile r)
   | .proofStep r => return toJson (← runProofStep r)
   | .pickleEnvironment r => return toJson (← pickleCommandSnapshot r)
   | .unpickleEnvironment r => return toJson (← unpickleCommandSnapshot r)
   | .pickleProofSnapshot r => return toJson (← pickleProofSnapshot r)
   | .unpickleProofSnapshot r => return toJson (← unpickleProofSnapshot r)
-  IO.println "" -- easier to parse the output if there are blank lines
+  printFlush "\n" -- easier to parse the output if there are blank lines

+/-- Verify each original closed root using the ordinary native kernel. -/
+def kernelCheckClosed (p : ProofSnapshot) : IO Bool := do
+  if !p.tacticState.goals.isEmpty || p.initialGoals.isEmpty then return false
+  let (checked, _) ← p.runMetaM do
+    for root in p.initialGoals do
+      root.withContext do
+        let value ← instantiateMVars (.mvar root)
+        if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then throwError "unresolved proof"
+        let mut locals : Array Expr := #[]
+        for decl in (← getLCtx) do
+          locals := locals.push (.fvar decl.fvarId)
+        let value ← Meta.mkLambdaFVars locals value
+        let type ← Meta.mkForallFVars locals (← root.getType)
+        let levels := ((collectLevelParams {} type).collect value).params.toList
+        let name ← mkFreshUserName `gpuSmtCheckedPrefix
+        let decl := Declaration.thmDecl {name,levelParams := levels,type,value}
+        match (← getEnv).addDeclCore 0 decl with
+        | .ok _ => pure ()
+        | .error _ => throwError "native kernel rejected closed root"
+    return true
+  return checked
+
 /-- Pretty print the current goals in the `ProofSnapshot`. -/
